string.name: c12_s4
string.value: 站来，现在对我来说是小菜一碟。

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: 哎呀…你总让我做同样的事儿。

string.name: c14_f3
string.value: 在这么多的人面前怎么便便呢？呜~

string.name: c15_s2
string.value: 哈哈~ 哎哟！差点儿踩到。

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: 现在不是嘘嘘时间啊。呜…

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: 主人，你去卫生间便便吧...

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: 今天便便的样子好可爱。

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: 很舒服。哎呀！你踩便便了。

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: 不想便便，你可以便便吗？

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: 因为早上什么都没吃，不会便便。

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: 看起来有点累，没事儿吧？

string.name: c17_s2
string.value: 买东西的时候，你注意别被骗。

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: 如果我饿的话，马上去我家，别饿着我。

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: 我最喜欢的一个词是我爱你呀。

string.name: c17_f1
string.value: 你看见过兔子说话的吗？

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: 现不是唠唠叨叨的时候。

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: 别总在一样的地方跑来跑去。

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: 只有一个人游戏，没意思。跟其他人亲密些会更好！

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: 这岛里有许多人。你不要忘记关心别人。

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: 我听说，在岛中央迷宫里有神殿。

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: 我们的宠物是叫射手村的科洛伊做的。

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: 主人，脑袋这么大呀！哈哈！

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: 虽然舍不得，但吃药水就会更强。

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: 你解决任务的话，说不定有好事。

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: 我没有说话。给我米饭吧。

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: 现在有点儿困，等会儿再跟你说。

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: 不怎么样，有没有更有意思的？

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: 讨厌！两三天没洗澡了吧？

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: 主人，你快点儿去洗澡，洗澡。

string.name: c22_s3
string.value: 在您的怀里感到很舒服啊。

string.name: c22_f1
string.value: 主人，你想我依偎着你吗？

string.name: c24_s3
string.value: 好瞌睡...用你的胳膊当枕头。行吗？

string.name: c24_s4
string.value: 我睡觉时，你不要一个人偷吃好吃的哦。

string.name: c24_f1
string.value: 主人，我还不累，跟我玩儿吧!

string.name: c24_f2
string.value: 我想要听起你唱催眠曲来睡觉。

string.name: c24_f3
string.value: 你想我睡觉的时候在我脸上乱写吧？

string.name: c27_s4
string.value: 哈哈！想向别的朋友炫耀。

string.name: c27_f1
string.value: 主人，我知道你说的是假的。

string.name: c28_f1
string.value: 你说的是不是心里话呀。

string.name: c28_f2
string.value: 刚才批评我，现在又爱我吗？

string.name: c28_f3
string.value: 你爱我，可为什么不给我米饭。

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: 喵呜~ 刚刚一直站着，好累呀...

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: 来~ 你也坐下休息休息。

string.name: c6_s3
string.value: 你怎么能和这么可爱的宠物生气呢？

string.name: c6_f1
string.value: 你总是这样吗，我告诉我妈！

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: 你总是这样，我告诉我妈啊！

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: 以后，绝对不会这样了。我向你发誓。

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: 啊哈~ 怎么样? 喵呜~

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: 主人，怎么样？做得不错吧？

string.name: c14_f3
string.value: 你怎么可以勉强嘘嘘呢？

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: 便便可以忍耐，可是嘘嘘无法忍啊。

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: 主人，禁止在公共场所嘘嘘。

string.name: c16_s1
string.value: 嘘嘘~~~ 今天，尿的颜色很鲜明。

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: 很舒服。哎！踩我嘘嘘了，怎么办呢？

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: 如果来不及，我马上就嘘嘘。

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: 主人，你怎么知道我想嘘嘘。啊！很舒服。

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: 我未来做什么比较好呢。你认为呢？

string.name: c17_s2
string.value: 上次，我看到了一碰就逃跑的那个小伙子。你知道为什么吗？

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: 长大的时候，应该给宠物更多的饲料。

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: 听说，有会飞行的可怕的怪物？我好想见一见。

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: 他想错了，以为宠物会说话。

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: 他想人们跟宠物可以沟通吧...

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: 有时要去一些没去过的地方旅游~

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: 听说，除了这儿以外，还有别的岛呢...

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: 听说，妖精不喜欢人。是不是？

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: 离居民区越远就有越强的怪物。

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: 听说，妖精很喜欢闪闪发亮的东西。

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: 上次航行中，我见到有人被海盗船袭击了。

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: 总是一样的饲料。我想要吃别的菜。

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: 原来，人们的脑袋这么大？奇怪。

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: 主人，怎么样？看得眼花缭乱吧。

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: 蝙蝠怪也不会有这么有力的目光。

string.name: c21_f2

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: 哎呀！太阳，睁不开眼睛了。

string.name: c22_s2

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: 주인님 꼭 지금 앉아야 되는 거에요? 멍멍멍~!

string.value: 뒷다리가 너무 짧아서 이렇게 앉아있는게 편해요... 히히...

string.name: c4_f2

string.name: c12_s3

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: 주인님 어떻게 그런 말을... 진심이 아닌거죠?

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: 아이 가려워. 그런 소리 말고 목욕이나 시켜줘요.

string.value: 헤헤... 밥을 너무 많이 먹었나봐... 멍멍~

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: 주인님... 응가한지 얼마 안 지났어요... 멍...

string.name: c15_f2

string.value: 취미가 뭐야? 나랑 같이 할수 있는거 였으면 좋겠다~ 멍멍~

string.value: 주인님 어째 요즘 배가 나온것 같은데요? 히히...

string.name: c19_f3

string.value: 변덕쟁이 말은 믿을 수 없어! 끼익!

string.name: c22_s3
string.value: 다리 아파~ 얼른 호~~ 해줘~ 끼익!

string.name: c23_s2
string.value: 히힛~ 내 귀여운 꼬리가 잘 보여~ 끼이익!

string.name: c23_s4
string.value: 너무 쉬워서 눈 감고도 할 수 있다구~ 끼익~

string.name: c23_f2
string.value: 하기 싫은데... 다른 거 하자~ 재미 없다구! 끼익!

string.name: c24_s1
string.value: 다리가 튼튼하니까 이런 것도 잘해~ 끼익!

string.name: c24_f4
string.value: 주인님 말 오늘은 안 들을 거야~ 끼이익~

string.name: c25_s1
string.value: 끼익~ 내 매력포인트는 바로 귀여운 꼬리라구~

string.name: c25_s3
string.value: 혼테일은 내가 한 방에 없앨 수 있는데..끽끽~

string.name: c25_f4
string.value: 밥 안주는 사람과 이야기하기 싫어~ 끼익~

string.name: c26_s1
string.value: 돼지는 밥을 많이 먹어...킥킥~ 그래서 돼지인가봐! 끽끽~

string.name: c26_s2
string.value: 끼익~ 바닷속 깊은 곳에 마녀가 살고 있다던데...

string.name: c26_s3
string.value: 난 빨리 재미있는 놀이를 하고 싶어~ 끼익!

string.name: c26_s4
string.value: 요새 외로운 것 같아... 나도 외롭다구~ 끼익!

string.name: c26_f2
string.value: 흥~ 하라고 하면 하기 싫어져~ 킥킥

string.name: c27_s1
string.value: 플로팅마켓에 가면 나같이 생긴 돌이 있어요! 끼익!

string.name: c27_s2
string.value: 주인님 머리 크기랑 내 머리 크기랑 똑같애~ 끼익!

string.name: c27_s3
string.value: 우리 주인님은 세계 최강이야~ 그렇죠? 끼이익?

string.name: c27_f4
string.value: 끼이익~ 심심해서 온 몸이 근질근질 하다구~!

string.name: c28_s1
string.value: 재미있는 거라도 알고 있는 거야? 끼익?

string.name: c29_s2
string.value: 숨바꼭질 하자~! 난 숨는 거 자신있다고! 끼익!

string.name: c29_s4
string.value: 난 노는 게 제일 좋아~♡ 끼익♡

string.name: c29_f3
string.value: 끼익~ 놀자고 하면 놀기 싫어~ 키킥

string.name: c30_s1
string.value: 주인님이랑 노는 거에요? 재미 있겠다♡ 끼익~

string.name: c30_s3
string.value: 오늘은 새로운 장소에 가서 놀아봐요~ 끼익!

string.name: c30_f2
string.value: 매일 놀기만 하면~ 사냥은 언제해요? 끼익?

string.name: c32_s2
string.value: 끽~~ 메롱하는 건 너무 재미 있어~!

string.name: c32_f4
string.value: 끼익... 난 시키면 괜히 하기 싫다구~ 킥킥~

string.name: c33_f2
string.value: 전 주인님을 놀릴 수 없어요~ 끼이익~

string.name: c34_f3
string.value: 자는 동안 도망가려고~~!! 흥~ 안 잘거야~ 끽끽~

string.name: c35_f4
string.value: 나 자는 동안 내 얼굴에 낙서할려구 그렇지? 끼익...

string.name: c2_s2
string.value: The ground is cold, but I'll sit.

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: You're right, I will take a seat.

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: So I just need to sit here, right, ho ho??

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: The sky is so nice... huh?

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: I don't want my feathers ruffled.

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: Take a seat? No problem! Gobble

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: You're so kind, Master. My legs were tired.

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: Ok, I'll get up when you say so.

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: I feel fine, but thanks for the offer... gobble.

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: An empty belly encourages me to disobey

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: A chickadee can follow that one. Too easy!

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: I do my best to obey, Master

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: A snack to show your appreciation would be nice

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: I don't like that look... I'm scared

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: You need a potion? You look funny...

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: I've been a good pet for you, be nice.

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: I have feelings too, I'm hurt

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: Sorry, Master. I'll obey from now on.

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: You already used your Mad ticket with me last time.

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: You're just shouting at me because you haven't eaten all day.

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: Not everyone can be a great Master, you'll get there with hard work.

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: Tada! You have such a good pet.

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: I'll always stand for my Master!

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: Maybe I don't hear so good.

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: Chickens may do that, but I do not.

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: My leg hurts, it needs to rest.

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: Truly, Turkeys are the best pets.

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: I needed to stretch. Thanks, Master!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: I can see your face better from here!

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: I want a challenge, Master. Standing is easy.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: Sticks and stones may break my bones, but only an oven can hurt me.

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: I only do what you tell me.

string.name: c14_f3
string.value: I didn't know you were a comedian, Master!

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: Are you asking me to agree?

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: Bested by a Turkey, you should feel bad.

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: Master, I only understand clear commands.

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: I only heard you say something about a wet sock. Sorry.

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: You're much smarter than I am, Master.

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: Your IQ must be really high!

string.name: c16_f1
string.value: I was under the impression that you were the smart one. I was wrong.

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: I think you left your brains back in the Hunting grounds.

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: Wait, look on the ground, next to the small rock. There it is! Your brain!

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: Aren't you supposed to lead me around? Sheesh.

string.name: c17_s2
string.value: Turkey can spot a scam anywhere. Watch out!

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: You have any Feed? It is delicious.

string.name: c17_f1
string.value: What is wrong with you? Turkeys can't talk!

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: I like to travel, Master. You can take me anywhere.

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: Where is everybody? I like seeing other Turkeys.

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: It's always a good thing when you're nice to everyone.

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: I think you might need a new hairdo.

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: A talking Turkey? Wake up--you're dreaming.

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: My voice hurts, so I'm resting it.

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: There was a feather in my ear. What did you say?

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: Turkeys are, by far, the best looking pet.

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: When are we going to see Zakum? I heard he's well armed!

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: Remember that doing quests can only help you!

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: The vocabulary of a turkey is not that developed!

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: Clear your voice and speak slowly.

string.name: c22_f2
string.value: You don't want to mess with a Turkey, do you?

string.name: c22_f3
string.value: When my stomach is empty, my ears get clogged.

string.name: c24_f2
string.value: I'm not buying what you're selling.

string.name: c24_f3
string.value: You must've been talking to that Mushroom over there.

string.name: c24_f4
string.value: Shaky hands? I see how it is...

string.name: c25_s2
string.value: Your love is the fuel that keeps me going.

string.name: c25_s3
string.value: Love is a battlefield, and you're my best weapon.

string.name: c25_s4
string.value: I can feel your love from here, Master...

string.name: c25_f1
string.value: I can't feel the love tonight.

string.name: c25_f4
string.value: I can tell you don't mean it!

string.name: c26_s1
string.value: If your love was money, I'd be a rich bird.

string.name: c26_s2
string.value: It's so nice to hear you say that!

string.name: c26_s3
string.value: My feathers only flap for you!

string.name: c26_f1
string.value: Right... you said that to someone else before

string.name: c26_f2
string.value: Oh, now you want to be affectionate? I don't think so.

string.name: c26_f3
string.value: The way to a Turkey's heart is through his stomach.

string.name: c27_s1
string.value: I've got my eye on you...

string.name: c27_s3
string.value: Go ahead. Wing it and see what happens...

string.name: c27_f2
string.value: Just for that, I'm closing my eyes.

string.name: c27_f3
string.value: Some food would help me see better...

string.name: c27_f4
string.value: My eyes tire of such trival sights.

string.name: c28_s2
string.value: This egg may give you superpowers. Use it wisely!

string.name: c28_s3
string.value: Much, much better than an apple.

string.name: c28_s4
string.value: Get some pepper and it will taste better.

string.name: c28_f1
string.value: I haven't laid an egg in a while, Master.

string.name: c28_f2
string.value: Someday, I may give you an egg. Today is not that day.

string.name: c28_f3
string.value: I don't have anything in my pockets. Guaranteed.

string.name: c28_f4
string.value: Better idea: How about you give ME an egg?

string.name: c29_s1
string.value: I think I got 2 inches off the ground that time!

string.name: c29_f2
string.value: Name the last time you saw a flying Turkey.

string.name: c29_f3
string.value: Haven't worked out my wings in a while, sorry.

string.name: c29_f4
string.value: I'd like to see you try. No jetpack, either.

string.name: c30_s3
string.value: Do I make you hungry, Master? Do I?

string.name: c30_s4
string.value: Go ahead, I've got another leg.

string.name: c30_f1
string.value: you're sick! Get away from me!

string.name: c30_f2
string.value: You're hungry too? That makes two of us.

string.name: c30_f3
string.value: No cranberry sauce? Or gravy? No dice.

string.name: c31_s3
string.value: I am feeling a little tired...

string.name: c31_f3
string.value: My eyes aren't heavy, why should I sleep?

string.name: c31_f4
string.value: Nowhere close to bedtime. I don't think so.

string.name: c32_s1
string.value: You're so observant, Master. I'll take a short nap.

string.name: c32_s2
string.value: Feeling pretty sleepy, a nap would be good for me.

string.name: c32_s4
string.value: This spot is perfect for a quick snooze.

string.name: c32_f1
string.value: Not unless you got a hen bed somewhere.

string.name: c32_f2
string.value: Unless you have a pillow, I'm not sleeping...

string.name: c32_f3
string.value: So you can cook me in an oven? Nice try.

string.name: c32_f4
string.value: I had a White Bull potion, I'm fine.

string.name: f2_f
string.value: ugh, there are onions in this!

string.name: f3_f
string.value: I don't think I'm hungry anymore.

string.name: f4_s
string.value: This looks like the best meal I've ever had...

string.name: s3
string.value: Told you not to say those words~

string.name: c23_s4
string.value: 我再次被主人迷住了~咕咕~

string.name: c23_s3
string.value: 我对主人的爱，应该怎么表现呢？咕～

string.name: c23_f4
string.value: 咕咕~我不需要什么爱。我是孤独的火鸡……

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: 不给我吃的，光说得好听……咕……

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: WEK~~ this is the way to do it, right?

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: Sit? Okay! I stll feel great though ~~~ WEK~ WEK~

string.name: c2_f1
string.value: You show me how to do it first...WEK

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: I never learned how to sit... weK!

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: Keep letting me do this ~~ WEK~

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: Do I sit like this? WEK!

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: You must be kidding me... WEK

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: Don't let me do stupid things like this... WEK..

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: It's not like I'll be getting a prize for doing this... WEK

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: I mastered the art of sitting.

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: I can sit! I really can sit!!

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: Give me something harder to do.

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: Wait til I turn back into a doll... then I'll sit.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: Look, I'm fat, and it's hard for me to sit.

string.name: c6_f2
string.value: And what are you trying to say? WEK!

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: Umm... you're no different than me. WEK!

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: Don't tell me what to do! WEK!

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: I won't do that again... WEK... WEK....

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: Okay now ... calm down ... WEK WEK..

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: I get it. I'll be a good penguin now.

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: What do you want me to do? WEK!

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: Did I do anything wrong? WEK?

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: My heart's been torn to pieces... sigh...

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: What can I do to make you feel better?

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: Hey, you're the one that started!

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: Seriously, I didn't do anything wrong.

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: Don't look! This is embarassing. WEK

string.name: c10_f2
string.value: Long way to go before I poop. WEK

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: I don't feel like pooping. WEK.

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: Hah, I ate a lil too much last night. WEK

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: Sorry. It's going to reak here. WEK.

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: I don't want anyone seeing this. WEK

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: I haven't felt it, yet. WEK.

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: Hey, don't look. It's not a pretty sight.

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: Ahhh, this is quite a relief.

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: You must really like the smell of poop.

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: I can't poop now. I held on to it for too long.

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: I can't poop what I never ate.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: Can you force yourself to poop?

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: Of course, the penguins must stand tall... WEK.

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: So I stand and sit, then stant and sit. WEK!

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: I don't want to do it, WEK!

string.name: c15_s2
string.value: This is a piece of cake, WEK.

string.name: c15_s4
string.value: I'm good, right? Give me something harder to do, WEK.

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: Can I do something else? I'm tired, WEK.

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: Don't tell me what to do, okay? WEK!

string.name: c16_s1
string.value: I can do it. I'm the bomb, right?

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: What other penguin can stand so beautifully like this?

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: If I keep practicing, I may be able to run one of these days.

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: Don't repeat the same thing over and over again.

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: The weather's beautiful today, perfect for a chit chat, WEK.

string.name: c17_s2
string.value: If you find somethng delicious, give me some, WEK.

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: Do you want to kiss me on the cheek? WEK!

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: I can help you out, WEK!

string.name: c17_f1
string.value: What? Who said I was fat? WEK!!

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: Have you ever seen a talking penguin? WEK.

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: Any good movie to watch, WEK?

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: Tell me you love me the most, WEK.

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: Treat others just the way you want to be treated, WEK.

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: Take me to a seafood store, WEK.

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: Don't feel like talking right now, WEK.

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: If I ever turn back into a doll, please get me a water of life so I can keep hanging out with you.

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: I'll help you gather up some items on the ground.

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: I see a lot of elves these days. I heard they were very hard-working.

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: Don't tell others your ID and password.

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: And what exactly do you want from me?

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: Don't bother me. I'm just chillin here.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: Now you gotta kiss me! WEK

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Hehe, give me a warm hug. WEK

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: I'm too heavy for you to hug, WEK.

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: I've been in need of some love these days... WEK.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: You can hug me as long as you want, WEK!

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: NO! You haven't showered in days! WEK!

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: I got no time for you, WEK!

string.name: c22_s2
string.value: Don't hug me too hard. I can't breathe.

string.name: c22_s4
string.value: Awwww, it's embarassing though. Hug me when no one's looking.

string.name: c23_f2
string.value: No, I wanna do something fun! WEK!

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: Look, it's well into the morning right now, WEK.

string.name: c23_f4
string.value: I don't feel like sleeping here, WEK.

string.name: c24_s1
string.value: Master, you sleep here with me. WEK.

string.name: c24_s3
string.value: I was about to sleep anyway.

string.name: c24_s4
string.value: You need to wake me up later.

string.name: c24_f1
string.value: Don't tell me what to do.

string.name: c24_f2
string.value: It's not time to sleep yet.

string.name: c24_f3
string.value: I feel fine, I don't feel like sleeping.

string.name: c26_s4
string.value: This makes me feel good, WEK!

string.name: c26_f1
string.value: This makes me feel good, WEK!

string.name: c26_f3
string.value: Liar. I don't like you, WEK.

string.name: c26_f4
string.value: Really? I don't think you do, though. WEK.

string.name: c27_s1
string.value: Do you really mean that, WEK?

string.name: c27_s2
string.value: You know how I feel about this, right? WEK~

string.name: c27_s3
string.value: I love you too, master! WEK!

string.name: c27_s4
string.value: Yay, I'm being loved by my master~ WEK!

string.name: c27_f1
string.value: And what do you want from me? WEK.

string.name: c27_f2
string.value: What? I didn't hear you. WEK.

string.name: c27_f4
string.value: I know you say that to others, too. WEK.

string.name: c28_s4
string.value: I love you too, master! Yay!!

string.name: c28_f2
string.value: We penguins don't take that phrase "I love you" lightly.

string.name: c28_f3
string.value: If you don't mean that, that I don't think you should say it.

string.name: c29_s3
string.value: So I should just stick it out like this? WEK..

string.name: c30_s2
string.value: You know I'm the bomb, WEK.

string.name: c30_f1
string.value: No way, I'm too tired. WEK.

string.name: c30_f2
string.value: I'm too lazy to do this. WEK.

string.name: c31_s2
string.value: Heavy, isn't it? I can't fly with these, though.

string.name: c31_s3
string.value: Is it fluffy? It feels good, right? This is fuuuun!

string.name: c31_f1
string.value: Ugh, this is quite a chore.

string.name: c31_f3
string.value: What am I, a dog? I'm a penguin, you know!

string.name: c32_s3
string.value: Make sure not to leave a hole on my cheek!

string.name: c32_f1
string.value: Um... do you know exactly where we are right now?

string.name: c32_f3
string.value: No way, I don't wanna do it.

string.name: c33_s3
string.value: Don't do it for too long, though. Yay!

string.name: c33_f1
string.value: Who in the right mind would wanna kiss you?

string.name: c33_f3
string.value: You ain't doing this for free.

string.name: c33_f4

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: 까칠이에게 예쁨 받고 싶어서 앉는 거 아냐!

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: 까칠~ 까칠~ 시키는 대로 했으면 쓰다듬어 줘야지!

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: 싫다! 이런 일은 다른 펫에게 시켜!

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: 까칠이 말 잘들으면 뭐가 좋은데? 우선 말해봐~ 도치~

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: 앉아? 난 3살 때부터 앉다라는 것을 잊어버렸어~!

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: 내가 앉으면 까칠이도 앉아야지! 까칠이가 힘들가봐 앉는거 아냐!

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: 도치~ 도치~ 이쁨 받고 싶어서 이런다고 생각하지마!

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: 까칠~ 내가 앉을거라고 기대하진마! 하지만 난 앉겠어~!

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: 단지 다리가 아파서 앉는 거뿐이야! 까칠이, 착각하지 마!

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: 까칠! 까칠! 이제 내 성격을 알 때가 되지 않았어?

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: 까칠이는 내가 말 잘 듣는 펫이라고 생각해? 그렇다면, 까칠한 착각이야~!

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: 도치! 도치! 정말 지겨워~! 왜 나만 앉으라고 그러는 거야?

string.name: c6_s3
string.value: 내가 까칠하다고......, 까칠이까지 이럴 필요는 없잖아!

string.name: c6_s4
string.value: 흑....... 더 까칠해 질 거야! 까칠~

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: 도치! 내 털이 서 있는거 안 보여?

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: 내가 이런 말을 듣고 살아야 한다니! 까칠!

string.name: c7_s1
string.value: 까칠? 그런 말 하지 마! 이젠 말 잘 들을게! 까칠.......

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: 까칠이? 왜 그래? 오늘 기분이 안좋아?

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: 미워! 까칠이가 내 마음에 바늘을 꽂았어! 도치!

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: 설마 나에게 한 말은 아니지? 잘 생각해봐! 도치~

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: 도치! 도치! 나 분노 중이야! 건드리지마! 도치!

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: 지금 그말 취소 못해? 나 까칠한거 몰라? 까칠!

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: 분명히 까칠이가 잘못 말한 거야! 나에게 이럴 수는 없어!

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: 까칠이! 그런 말 하지 마! 이젠 주인님이라고 부를게? 응?

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: 내가 까칠이 말에 상처받아서 우는 게 아니야! 그냥 눈물을 흘리고 싶을 뿐이야!

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: 주인님! 미안해! 이젠 까칠하게 말 안 할게! 이제 마음 풀어!

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: 왜 이러지? 왜 눈물이 나지? 그냥 까칠이가 말한 것뿐이잖아.......

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: 자꾸 그런 말 하면, 이 까칠한 털로 확~ 찔러버릴 거야!

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: 까칠! 까칠! 내가 이런 말 듣고 살아야 하나....... 확 굶어 죽어야지.......

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: 까칠~ 그런 말은 까칠한 내 가슴에 통하지 않는다. 좀 더 심한 말 좀 해봐!

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: 알았어! 알았다고! 도치~ 이제야 나를 파악한 건가? 도치~

string.value: 메~ 롱! 어때? 까칠이 슬슬 화가 나지? 도치~

string.value: I have nothing to say to you...KROWL...!

string.name: c25_f4
string.value: How am I supposed to talk? I'm a tiger, KROWL!

string.name: c26_s2
string.value: I have a feeling a nice item may come our way today! KROWL!

string.name: c26_s3
string.value: Master, you'll get me some goood food today, right? KROWL~

string.name: c26_s4
string.value: Let's go to the beach today! I wanna do something fun!!

string.name: c26_f1
string.value: I don't have anything to say...KROWL...

string.name: c27_s1
string.value: Master, are you dating someone? I'm not...

string.name: c27_s4
string.value: How's Ludibrium? I heard that place is nice...

string.name: c27_f1
string.value: I'm hungry, why doncha just feed me?

string.name: c27_f2
string.value: You must be really really really bored...

string.name: c27_f3
string.value: I can't hear you~ I can't hear you~

string.name: c27_f4
string.value: I'm tired, and I don't feel like talking today.

string.name: c28_s1
string.value: My gosh, I feel ...really... sad right now.

string.name: c28_s2
string.value: Even I have to admit, THIS is a sad look...

string.name: c28_f1
string.value: No way! I don't feel like doing it right now!

string.name: c28_f2
string.value: Why don't YOU do it, stupid!

string.name: c29_s1
string.value: Sniff ... I've never felt so sad in my life.

string.name: c29_s3
string.value: Alright, I'll show you my whole repretoir today!

string.name: c29_f1
string.value: I don't feel like acting right now...

string.name: c29_f2
string.value: I know I'm good at making sad faces, but now's not the time.

string.name: c29_f3
string.value: I'm not in a good mood!

string.name: c30_s1
string.value: Sniff ... I've never felt so sad in my life.

string.name: c30_s3
string.value: Alright, I'll show you my whole repretoir today!

string.name: c30_f1
string.value: I don't feel like acting right now...

string.name: c30_f2
string.value: I know I'm good at making sad faces, but now's not the time.

string.name: c30_f3
string.value: I'm not in a good mood!

string.name: c31_s1
string.value: I'll just leave my paws out here and wait for ya~

string.name: c31_f1
string.value: How am I supposed to know how long I should wait here?

string.name: c32_s1
string.value: Okay~ I'll sit here and wait!

string.name: c32_s3
string.value: I'll just sit here and wait til you come back, master~

string.name: c32_f2
string.value: Arrgh...I don't feel like doing this.

string.name: s4
string.value: If you say bad words, I am gonna ban you!

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: Wonderful, I was almost out of breath.

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: Sure, I was tired at any rate.

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: I'm not in the mood to rest quite yet.

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: Not a bad spot, I suppose...

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: You can't hear them, but my legs send their gratitude.

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: Maybe you need a break, but I don't.

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: Thanks for your concern, but I'm fine.

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: Do not pin your need for rest on me. If you are tired, sit.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: Look, you lead me around. What do you expect?

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: This is what happens when you don't feed me.

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: Oh I'm sorry, did your weapon get in the way of my tail?

string.name: c5_s1
string.value: Your initial reaction denotes you're not a happy camper.

string.name: c5_s2
string.value: My sorrow lingers like a spoiled pie within my belly.

string.name: c5_s4
string.value: Sincerest apologies, my friend. It won't happen again.

string.name: c5_f1
string.value: Don't blame me--I did think of that!

string.name: c5_f2
string.value: My fault? I think not, kind sir.

string.name: c5_f3
string.value: Again, you place fault where none exists.

string.name: c5_f4
string.value: Yea right. Try giving me a task I can do.

string.name: c6_s1
string.value: If I've hurt you, I'm sorry.

string.name: c6_s4
string.value: A mistake on my part, I'm sorry.

string.name: c6_f1
string.value: You assume that something has gone wrong.

string.name: c6_f2
string.value: What if I wanted to do that? Exactly...

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: Maybe if I sprayed you accidentally...you'd see it my way.

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: Civil Disobedience is every Skunk's right!

string.name: c7_s1
string.value: Lounging...an activity suited for the wise and well-off Skunk.

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: This is an activity I'll gladly do.

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: Only thing I need now is a snack...

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: Let me know when we hit the beach, and I'll think about it.

string.name: c9_s2
string.value: One can often find comfort in the small things.

string.name: c9_s3
string.value: Nothing like good company and a good snack!

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: Definitely more than a drop in the bucket.

string.name: c10_f1
string.value: Without toilet paper? You must think me undignified!

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: I need food before I need to relive myself.

string.name: c10_f4
string.value: Skunks only have gas. You know this.

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: Not too shabby, if I do say so myself!

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: Find a Husky if you wish to be vulgar.

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: Skunks have too much pride to relieve themselves in the open!

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: My gift left in there is best known as a sight unseen.

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: Not too hard, not too soft. Perfect.

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: Um, that was a bit wet. I'm so embarrassed.

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: I think I broke the toilet...

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: I'll keep my dignity, thank you.

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: I flushed your request down the toilet where it belongs.

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: Was that some kind of obnoxious joke?

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: Perhaps you have me confused with another animal...

string.name: c13_s1
string.value: You're taller than I, but not as tall as a Yeti. With or without Pepe.

string.name: c13_s2
string.value: Apparently, you never seem to get wet after swimming in Aqua Road.

string.name: c13_s3
string.value: Fun Fact: I'm an omnivore, not a vegetarian.

string.name: c13_s4
string.value: I prefer to be alone, but I've grown rather fond of you...

string.name: c13_f3
string.value: There are no words I have to express my disdain at your previous request.

string.name: c14_s1
string.value: The true measure of a Mapler can be found not when they're at their best, but at their worst.

string.name: c14_s2
string.value: Fun Fact: Skunks actually enjoy walks on the beach.

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: When are we visiting the Affluent Tower in New Leaf City?

string.name: c14_s4
string.value: Often times, I ask myself, what exactly is in the special sauce?

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: Next thing, you'll be asking me to play fetch!

string.name: c14_f3
string.value: Yes, I can talk. Get over it.

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: Sometimes, just sometimes, I smile at you.

string.name: c15_s2
string.value: I only spray my enemies as a last resort.

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: Fun Fact: I'm pretty close to blind. I just hear extremely well.

string.name: c15_s4
string.value: Friends don't let Friends say "Mesos plox".

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: Don't make me get anal on you.

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: I got nothing for you. Nothing!

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: In order to speak, I need energy. For energy, I must eat. Is that clear?

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: I think I'm ready for something new.

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: I try to keep an open mind about these things.

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: I'd believe your words, yet your actions lie.

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: Let me guess, Moony divorced you.

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: I'm quite easy to fall in love with.

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: All it takes is a few weeks.

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: I feel something for you too.

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: I'm beginning to feel something...gas! Did you think it was something else?

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: No, you just think you do.

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: My heart beats a tiny bit faster whenever you're near.

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: I only wish I could better show the depths of my affection for you.

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: I'm just not ready for that kind of commitment yet.

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: You just love me for my tail.

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: Fascinating...you have fallen in love with a Skunk!

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: I feel a lot closer to you, now.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: I wanted a hug from you, too.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Hugging is a talent, and you definitely got it!

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: No food, no hug. Simple concept.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: It's a rare treat to find one who can express so much through a hug.

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: Space is what I need right now. Thanks for understanding.

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: I'm of the mind that we can express ourselves...at a distance.

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: That's just not what I'm looking for right now.

string.name: c22_s3
string.value: Should've laid off those cherry pies. And grilled cheese. And Cakes. And...

string.name: c22_f1
string.value: So...what are you trying to say?!

string.name: c22_f3
string.value: I believe the proper term is overweight.

string.name: c22_f4
string.value: Let me know when you see a fat skunk.

string.name: c23_s1
string.value: Gaining weight is fun, but keeping it on isn't.

string.name: c23_s3
string.value: And I thought I actually lost weight...

string.name: c23_s4
string.value: Nothing but roots and berries from here on out!

string.name: c23_f2
string.value: Right. Time to polish your glasses.

string.name: c23_f4
string.value: The fault lies not just with me, but with you as well.

string.name: c24_s3
string.value: I can find it, just bear with me!

string.name: c24_s4
string.value: I think it's over here, wait. Never mind.

string.name: c24_f3
string.value: One does not insult a skunk, for various reasons.

string.name: c25_s2
string.value: There's something around here..I know it!

string.name: c25_s3
string.value: I feel like I'm closing in on something...

string.name: c25_f2
string.value: I feel bad, thanks a lot!

string.name: c25_f4
string.value: It's not easy being me, you could be nicer!

string.name: c26_s1
string.value: Stop. It's not what you think it is.

string.name: c26_f3
string.value: What, may I ask, did you expect?

string.name: c26_f4
string.value: You should try smelling yours one day.

string.name: c27_f1
string.value: You know, your breath isn't exactly 'sweet-smelling' either.

string.name: c27_f2
string.value: I ate snail burgers. Sue me.

string.name: c27_f4
string.value: I do not have bad breath!

string.name: c28_s2
string.value: Ready for a night on the town?

string.name: c28_f1
string.value: Long night last night, so I need rest.

string.name: c29_s4
string.value: Uh, that other Skunk did it.

string.name: c29_f1
string.value: Would you rather have it out here or indoors.

string.name: c29_f2
string.value: And what? Yours smells like roses and chocolate?

string.name: c29_f3
string.value: Contrary to popular belief, yours stink too.

string.name: c30_s4
string.value: Why don't you nap with me?

string.name: c30_f4
string.value: I can go all day and all night!

string.name: c31_s3
string.value: I'm going to get some zzzz.

string.name: c31_f2
string.value: Got to keep an eye out for monsters...

string.name: c31_f3
string.value: The ground is too hard here.

string.name: c31_f4
string.value: It's a bit cold here for me.

string.name: c32_s1
string.value: I guess this is as good a spot as any...

string.name: c33_s3
string.value: I'm the best. You know this.

string.name: c34_s1
string.value: When the going gets tough, the tough call a skunk!

string.name: c34_f2
string.value: Boldness isn't always a strong suit.

string.name: c34_f3
string.value: Stop trying to kiss my tail.

string.name: c34_f4
string.value: So, what are you really after?

string.name: c35_s1
string.value: Hold on, getting some dirt off my shoulder.

string.name: c35_s2
string.value: Remember, you're dealing with the best.

string.name: c35_f1
string.value: Flattery is often seen as a ploy of those with nothing else to offer.

string.name: c35_f2
string.value: There's a point where flattery begins to sound hollow.

string.name: c35_f3
string.value: I don't know what you're after, but you won't get it from me.

string.name: f3_f
string.value: A meal fit for a ruffian. Take it away!

string.name: s2
string.value: Kyuu... I am not gonna say that.

string.name: s3
string.value: I am not the kind of Rabbit who speaks of evil words,~

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: 편안한 의자에 앉아 시원한 주스를~ 아루~

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: 내 가방안에 뭐가 들었는지 알아? 아루~

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: 키노는 편안한 릴렉스 체어에서 쉬고 싶어요~

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: 키노는 주인님과 신나는 모험을 떠나고 싶어요~♬

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: 아루루~ 오늘은 조금 피곤해요. 주인님은 어떠세요?

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: 주인님은 어쩜 그렇게 멋질 수가 있어요?

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: 릴렉스 체어에 앉아서 시원한 주스를 한잔하고 싶어요~

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: 아루~아루루~ 키노는 주인님과 함께 있어서 너~무 행복해요♡

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: 아루! 주인님 제가 재미난 얘기해드릴까요? 호호호 그건 다음에~

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: 고백을 하려면 반짝이는 예쁜 돌이라도 준비했어야죠!

string.name: c22_s2
string.value: 두눈을 꼭 감고 귀를 막아도 주인님만 떠올라요~♡

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: I do this for you, you do something else for me. Deal?

string.name: c2_f2
string.value: I can't hear you. Speak up!

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: I don't understand what you're saying...

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: This is an easy, easy command. Pssh.

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: I was just about to sit, but not because you ordered me to.

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: This is why I carry around a chair at all times.

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: I am not used to sitting around a place like this...

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: Do you think I only do things at your command?

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: Have you seen my chair? You know I can't sit without one.

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: You know you want to sit, too. Too bad this chair has a weight limit!

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: Hey, I looked up advanced robots online and saw an awesome movie. Did you see it?

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: I'm not trying as tall as you. I'm just...used to sitting here.

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: That was the one command I didn't want to hear today.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: You first. Then I'll think about it.

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: Why don't you go dance with hectors first?

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: Don't tell me to do things I don't want to do!

string.name: c5_f2
string.value: I'm not sleepy. I want to do something else.

string.name: c6_s2
string.value: I'm going to sleep now. See you tomorrow.

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: There's nothing like sleeping at home...

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: Did you secretly upload a sleeping program to my system? Why do I feel so sleepy?

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: I'll need to sleep now. My skin needs it.

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: I don't like sleeping. I like playing with you.

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: It's still bright outside. Why do you want me to sleep?

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: Can we do something other than sleep?

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: I don't want to sleep. I want to play around with you.

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: I'm going to dream about flying tonight! Zzzzzzz

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: Ah, it's time to go to bed already. Good night!

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: I wanted to hang out with you more...but I'm so sleepy...

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: Shhh, I think there's a monster around the area.

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: I need a lullaby to fall asleep...

string.name: c10_s1
string.value: What made you so mad at me?

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: Don't talk like that. I'm scared.

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: Do you really want to yell at me like that?

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: You were going to hit me. Ahhh!!

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: Why do you make me cry?

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: You need to tell me what I did wrong...

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: You're the only one I've got...I feel like crying now.

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: I'll do better next time...but what exactly do I have to do better?

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: Do you have to talk to me like that?

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: Don't let your frustrations out on me. Do it on the monsters!

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: What exactly did I do wrong?

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: You must be bored, aren't you?

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: Hey, I'm the most obedient robot you'll ever find.

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: What are you trying to say?

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: I love you like a computer loves it's monitor.

string.name: c15_s2
string.value: Ahhh... that just made my day.

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: Good, if you want to be in my good graces, this is the way to do it.

string.name: c15_s4
string.value: Wait, can you say that one more time?

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: Hey, a joke is a joke. Make it sound like one.

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: You are NOT the first person to say that... but thanks anyways.

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: It's so hard to be loved by people...I must have a talent for that.

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: You don't need to say that out loud. I know you do.

string.name: c16_f1
string.value: I'm sick of hearing that now. So many people keep telling me they love me.

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: I want to hear that from a hot robot!

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: That's the 234234th time I heard that. Sigh.

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: That's what Bloctopus told me last night.

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: You didn't just say what I think you did...

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: What have I done to deserve this?

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: You seem more stupid than I am...

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: I am not stupid! I am smart!

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: What makes you think you can say that?

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: Keep telling me that, and one day I'll run away!

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: I just saved that in my memory bank. I'll keep that in mind.

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: Can't we just all get along?

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: Look, if I had a single digit IQ, I'd be mad too. It's ok.

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: Ok, genius. What's the last digit of Pi? Thought so...

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: I am much smarter than you.

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: Are you having fun tormenting me?

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: Really? Is it really that fun to make fun of me?

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: Why are you doing this to me? I'm nice and good looking.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Even a heart of steel like mine will crack if you keep saying that.

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: I'll hate you for that. Seriously.

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: I'll be better. Don't hate me.

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: I don't feel like doing that.

string.name: c22_s1
string.value: Bring it on! Bring it on!!!

string.name: c22_s3
string.value: I'm ready to fire away! Muahahah!!!

string.name: c22_f2
string.value: Isn't it beautiful outside? Let's walk around.

string.name: c22_f4
string.value: I believe in peace, not war.

string.name: c23_s2
string.value: I'll attack. You go pick up the items.

string.name: c23_s3
string.value: Show me if you can find someone who can shoot better than me!

string.name: c23_s4
string.value: I don't need to aim. I'll just fire away!!!

string.name: c23_f1
string.value: Hmmm...my tail seems to be working well.

string.name: c23_f2
string.value: Lalala! What did you just say?

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: It's so nice outside. Let's go camping!

string.name: c24_s1
string.value: Press 1 to speak to a talking robot, press 0 to repeat the message.

string.name: c24_s2
string.value: Do you think I can meet up with other robots like me at Ludibrium?

string.name: c24_s3
string.value: What's the tallest tower in the world? Eos Tower, of course!

string.name: c24_s4
string.value: I think I am by far the best looking robot here...

string.name: c24_f1
string.value: Do you need someone to talk to?

string.name: c24_f2
string.value: I don't think I can talk to you...

string.name: c25_s1
string.value: Do you want to know how smart I am? Much smarter than you!!

string.name: c25_s2
string.value: Any hot robots around here? I can't find any...

string.name: c25_s3
string.value: I am so lonely. Introduce me to other robots!!!

string.name: c25_s4
string.value: Dragon Roar!!!! Wait, why can't I do this?

string.name: c25_f2
string.value: I'm sorry I only have one mouth to speak.

string.name: c25_f3
string.value: I can't express myself with words...

string.name: c26_s1
string.value: Promise me to show me if you ever run across an amazing part for robots!

string.name: c26_s2
string.value: A few days ago, I saw this incredible thing that's covered in gold light. He seemed quite familiar...

string.name: c26_s3
string.value: I talked to Jr. Balrog yesterday, and he wanted to have a word with you...alone.

string.name: c26_s4
string.value: Arwen, Rowen, and Mar are in a love triangle. Why? Because of me!!!

string.name: c26_f1
string.value: Did I sleep too late last night? I'm tired.

string.name: c26_f2
string.value: Arwen said she likes quiet men.

string.name: c26_f3
string.value: Did I talk too much today? I feel like my wires have burnt out for the day.

string.name: c26_f4
string.value: Let's stop talking and start hunting.

string.name: c27_s1
string.value: Just tell me where the monsters are.

string.name: c27_s4
string.value: How about transforming in the morning, afternoon, and nighttime?

string.name: c27_f2
string.value: I don't feel like doing that.

string.name: c27_f3
string.value: This isn't fun. I don't want to do it.

string.name: c28_s1
string.value: Now transforming to the hottest robot in this world.

string.name: c28_s2
string.value: I deal with the monsters. You deal with the items.

string.name: c28_s3
string.value: Size has nothing to do with power.

string.name: c28_f2
string.value: You know, I can't do EVERYTHING for you.

string.name: c28_f3
string.value: I don't care if you call me a bad robot.

string.name: c28_f4
string.value: I say no to anyone that orders me to do something.

string.name: c29_s1
string.value: Now transforming to the most powerful, spectacular, amazing, sexiest robot ever!

string.name: c29_s2
string.value: I bet you no one else can do this!

string.name: c29_s3
string.value: Now transforming to...Meso Rangers!!! Wait, that's not it.

string.name: c29_s4
string.value: More than meets the--wait...I can't say that!

string.name: c29_f1
string.value: I don't think you realize just how hard it is to transform.

string.name: c29_f3
string.value: Dude...do you want eat some of this iron fists?

string.name: c29_f4
string.value: Do you realize how stupid I feel firing away at nothing?

string.name: f1_f
string.value: What are you trying to do?

string.name: f2_f
string.value: My batteries have been charged already.

string.name: f3_s
string.value: I am at my happiest eating.

string.name: f3_f
string.value: It's not time to charge batteries yet!

string.name: f4_s
string.value: How did you know I was so hungry?

string.name: f4_f
string.value: I know I can eat a lot, but not THAT much.

string.name: s4
string.value: If you say bad words, I am gonna ban you!

string.name: e_levelup
string.value: Congratulations! You're still a long way from my level, though!

string.name: e_rest
string.value: Are you bored? What are you doing?

string.name: e_HPAlert
string.value: I think I saw something blink...hey, are you alright?

string.name: e_prelevelup
string.value: A little more, and you'll level up! Keep going!

string.name: e_NOHPPotion
string.value: I don't have any HP potions to give you. Check your inventory.

string.name: e_NOMPPotion
string.value: I don't have any MP potions to give you. Check your inventory.
You don't look too good... maybe you should change your skin color.
It's time for a phone call from my lover #23.
It's time for a phone call from my lover #234.
It's time for a phone call from my lover #2567.
My goal is to make 10,000 lovers. You?
Would it look weird if I wear an earring?
Hey what's the most popular style in Henesys these days? Don't tell me it's what you're wearing...
Do you understand how many dates I have to decline in order to be with you?
I only talk to you so you won't get too bored.
Hey, whatever I told you right now is a secret, okay?
I like hanging out with you!
Why do women love small, shiny objects?
Don't you remember struggling against snails?
We've been walking too much. Let's go to Aqua Road and rest.
If you know any nice restaurants, take me there!

string.value: Kling klang! At your command, master.

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: Kling klang! Just input the right command, and I'll do the rest.

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: Perfect command. You are a computer master! Kling klang!

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: Kling klang! I won't site until you sit first.

string.value: An error has occurred! Please double check the command. Beep! Beep!

string.value: "Sit" is such a great keyword for all pets... Kling klang!

string.value: Oh oops! I almost farted while sitting down. Kling klang!

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: You know exactly what I want. I really wanted to sit right now...

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: Hmmm...an important program that lets me sit is corrupt. I can't do it..heh

string.value: I want to talk today, master, beep beep!

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: Beep beep! Grrr...I can't move right now due to an error.

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: Make me move first. I don't see a lot of effort on your part.

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: Ahhhh!! I almost cramped up my legs.

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: Like this? Precise commands yield smart pets like me.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: I feel too weak to stand.

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: You just told me to sit. Jeez! Make up your mind!

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: How many times do I have to tell you? You're saying it all wrong!

string.name: c5_s3
string.value: I'm in tip top shape right now. I'll follow your command.

string.name: c5_f2
string.value: Beep beep beep...ahh I gotta just sit.

string.name: c5_f3
string.value: My body's not functioning right today. Just let it go.

string.name: c6_s2
string.value: Master, you have been verified! Will stand now!

string.name: c6_f2
string.value: Are you my master? Enter your ID and PW.

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: Are you trying to get another pet with a different color? I can read your mind, you know.

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: Due to system overload, I cannot process commands for the rest of the day. Time for me to rest.

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: I want love and affection from my master. What's wrong with you?

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: You are a bigger dummy than I am.

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: Who? What? What did you say?

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: If you say so...then it is so...

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: I am a fool for your love, master.

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: I don't understand what you're saying.

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: Now you're saying this. Do I look that easy?

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: Unrecognizable word. I don't know what you're talking about.

string.name: c9_s2
string.value: I may be dumb, but I still follow your commands.

string.name: c9_s3
string.value: If I got fixed on time...I'd be the best robot in this world.

string.name: c9_s4
string.value: Stupid...? What do I need, a virus scan? Run it right now!

string.name: c9_f1
string.value: Master, you must be afraid of me.

string.name: c9_f2
string.value: First time hearing it. I can't find the resulting value for that command.

string.name: c9_f3
string.value: If you don't like me... then oh well, good riddance.

string.name: c9_f4
string.value: An error has occurred. Please leave. Beep beep!

string.name: c10_s1
string.value: What did I do wrong...? Shooooo...

string.name: c10_s2
string.value: I won't do that again. Please love me. Shooooo...

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: I'm sorry. I'll be better next time. Shooooo...

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: I'm only doing this to catch your attention. Shoooo...

string.name: c10_f1
string.value: What did you just say? I didn't do anything wrong!

string.name: c10_f2
string.value: My ears hurt... Stop nagging on me, master!!!

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: I hate you! You keep ragging on me for no reason!

string.name: c10_f4
string.value: Is that some foreign language? I don't understand a word of what you're saying...

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: I'm sorry...I didn't do that on purpose.

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: Are you really mad? I'm sorry...

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: Are you messing with me? What did I do wrong?

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: So you're in a bad mood...that doesn't mean you can go off on me like that!

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: I have no idea what you're saying right now.

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: I did nothing wrong! It's all you!!

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: That was my bad. I won't ever do that again.

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: I'll do better now. Please don't hate me!

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: Are you just trying to pick something with me?

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: Master, you need to loosen up a bit!

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: Seriously, it's really not that serious.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: I was trying to apologize, but I don't like your attitude.

string.name: c13_s2
string.value: Don't you like how I do all this for you?

string.name: c13_s3
string.value: Wow, you really want to hold my hand?

string.name: c13_f1
string.value: Hands? I only have feet... Shoooo...

string.name: c13_f2
string.value: Do I have to give you my hand when you're asking for it? Nah...

string.name: c13_f3
string.value: Are you trying to play rock paper and scissors?

string.name: c14_s1
string.value: Am I sweet or what? Love me!!!

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: Master, aren't you the nice one!

string.name: c14_s4
string.value: Here...I think my right hand looks better than left.

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: You don't even help me get a pedicure on my nails.

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: Here! Please help me get a pedicure.

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: I'm sleepy...why are you asking this to me?

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: I know what you mean. I understand...

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: You were scolding me just now, and now you love me? Whatever.

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: Have you been secretly liking me for a while?

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: Seriously, is that all you got? Find another way to say that.

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: I think you're really into me now. Muahahaha.

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: Oh wow, my face is turning red.

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: I really really love you, too.

string.name: c17_f1
string.value: What? What did you say? I didn't hear you.

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: Do you need me for a favor? I won't do it.

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: I love someone else. I'm sorry.

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: Wow...I can feel your love penetrating through my heart...

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: I love you, master! I really do!

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: I don't feel the love. I'm hungry.

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: I thought you were dating someone. Pssshhh..

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: You're empty handed. You expect me to accept you without anything?

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: I've heard that quite often, but...you're not my type.

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: I know I have a luscious voice. If you really want to hear it...ahem.

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: I want to talk to other people, too.

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: I am a robot. That's it.

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: I need to be greased up. I feel clunky.

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: You said that I was too loud. Sheesh, make up your mind.

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: I want to go see other places. Take me take me!

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: Really...I can't stand you... NOT! You know I love you.

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: Who are you? And who am i??

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: I want something delicious...and I want a shirt or two...Can you pay for them?

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: I have nothing to say...why don't you say something instead?

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: I am tired! I talked a lot! It's your turn!

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: I have a wish...will you do it for me?

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: You are an awesome friend of mine! Thanks!!

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: So you haven't forgotten me...we need more time to talk like this!

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: Wow...why does it feel like whenever you ask me to say something, I get tired all of a sudden?

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: What? What did you say? I didn't hear you.

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: I don't feel like talking right now. Maybe some other time.

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: Shhhh...I can't say this right now. I'll tell you later.

string.name: c22_s3
string.value: Don't I look awesome like this?

string.name: c22_s4
string.value: I'm ready now. Just say go!

string.name: c23_s1

string.name: c23_s2

string.name: c23_s3

string.name: c23_f1

string.name: c23_f2
string.value: I AM TIRED! Let me just sleep.

string.name: c24_s3

string.name: c24_s4

string.name: c24_f3

string.value: I really don't feel like talking.

string.name: c1_s2
string.value: 我可以依偎在你身旁嗎？

string.name: c1_s3
string.value: 你不坐在我身旁嗎？皮卡~~

string.name: c1_s4
string.value: 好，我就一直坐著直到你叫我站起為止…皮卡~

string.name: c1_f1
string.value: 不是，我需要更多的練習…

string.name: c1_f2
string.value: 我喜歡躺在豪華真皮沙發上。

string.name: c1_f3
string.value: 我不會那麼做！皮卡皮卡！！

string.name: c1_f4
string.value: 我不是什麼地方都能坐下的！

string.value: 唔…感覺好像坐在一朵雲上。

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: 當然，我可以也翹起我的二郎腿嗎？

string.name: c2_f2
string.value: 我不是什麼地方都能坐下的！

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: 拍拍我的鬆弛肚皮。皮卡皮卡！

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: 嗯…你覺得我坐下的時候能動到我的腳指嗎？

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: 肚子飽飽，天氣好好…主人也很好！

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: 你有尾巴嗎？它能幫助你坐下時不會往後翻。試試看吧。

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: 我…我不能。如果你不撫著我的話，我會往後翻滾的。

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: 這個地方令我覺得不大舒服。

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: 很不幸運…我並不能控制你的想法。

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: 我從一個瑜珈師父那學會這個坐姿！

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: 皮卡啾可以要一個雞腿嗎？拜托~~~

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: 我能在不往後翻的情況下好好的坐著幾分鐘。

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: 終於有機會歇一歇我的短腿了。

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: 在你還沒有禮貌的說話前都不會…

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: 再命令我一句我就叫皮卡啾咬你！

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: 哼…你又覺得累了？你好弱！

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: 哼！ 你想趁我終於坐下輕鬆的時候拿走我的食物！ ？

string.name: c5_s2
string.value: 啊…我剛剛那痲痺的尾巴給了我很大的麻煩。

string.value: 我從這次的錯誤學習到了…對不起。

string.value: 你是這樣對待你的寵物的嗎？

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: 我媽媽不認同你的看法。

string.value: 不是|糟糕|糟糕的女孩|糟糕的男孩

string.value: 撥弄|惡臭|傀儡|我討厭你

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: 皮卡啾好害怕主人…皮卡~~~

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: 是的…但我還是去到哪裡都跟隨你~

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: 主人，你好差勁！ 皮卡！

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: 粉紅不再是你最愛的顏色了？*抽泣*…

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: 你能?原諒我嗎？對不起…我不是有意的。

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: 你是什麼意思？我向你學的…

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: 我會向所有人宣佈你是一個很糟糕的主人！

string.value: 我會開始做瘦身運動…那你會比較喜歡我嗎？

string.value: 我所做的都是為了得到你的注意。皮卡皮卡~~~

string.value: 這裡太吵了，我聽不見你的說話。

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: 你的心情不好…但不代表你能當我是你的出氣筒！

string.value: 我不能控制我上廁所得時間。

string.value: 最靠近的粉紅廁所在哪裡？

string.name: c15_f2

string.name: c15_f4

string.value: 啊…優質高纖緯食物的效果

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: 喔…我覺得我的肚子越來越小了…

string.name: c16_f1
string.value: 不是現在，優先放入我的待辦事項清單吧

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: 我不想弄髒這個美麗得地方

string.value: 如果我說話的話我就平衡不了我自己…

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: 你想知道我是怎麼得到這條尾巴的嗎？

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: 你知道為什麼我叫皮卡啾嗎…？其實我看起來更像隻老鼠…

string.value: 烤豆…咖啡豆…果凍豆…沒有一個能恰當的形容我。

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: 我走到累時就在地上翻滾。皮卡噗~~

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: 安靜下來，別再讓我說話。

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: 你不知道達爾利和達爾米都不是真的兔子嗎？拍半慢…

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: 我不想躲在角落鬧情緒。

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: 我手短…不能?同時拍拍我的頭之餘還摸摸我的肚子。

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: 你見到我爸爸，皮卡啾先生了嗎？

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: 誰能給洛尼一個奶嘴？他常常吮他的手指…

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: 你覺得我有可能有雙下巴嗎？

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: 光說沒用…快開始行動吧！

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: 穿上你的鞋子…你的腳有臭味…

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: 有時當我仔細的看著你…我發現…你其實沒那麼聰明…

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: 當你在我身邊，我覺得很舒服。

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: 有你在身邊的感覺很棒。

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: *睏*…和你一起我快悶慌了…Z z z…

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: 用你的愛包圍我吧~皮卡~

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: 我對`我愛你'這句話的感受比世上任何一樣事情更深！

string.value: 愛…？哀…？算了，我還是坐下來摸摸我的肚子好了

string.name: c22_s4
string.value: 隨著時間的流逝，我越來越喜歡你了…

string.name: c22_f1
string.value: 我不明白。開始你說討厭我，現在你說愛我？

string.name: c22_f2
string.value: 別撒謊…我那脆弱的心是很容易破碎的。

string.name: c22_f3
string.value: 我現在很忙。能晚點再談嗎？

string.name: c22_f4
string.value: 不會是認為我對你有任何好感吧，是嗎？

string.name: c23_s3
string.value: 你不會被我那酷斃的舞步震攝住嗎？

string.name: c23_s4
string.value: 皮卡啾街頭舞蹈時間~保證你眼花撩亂~

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: 別認為這是我的唯一興趣…

string.name: c23_f4
string.value: 我不是娛樂大眾的寵物

string.name: c24_s1
string.value: 來見識我的不停歇超級舞步~

string.name: c24_f1
string.value: 非得你給我更多食物不行

string.name: c25_s3
string.value: 你不可能和我做這一樣可愛…*鬼臉*

string.name: c25_s4
string.value: 我的口水濺到你滿臉都是了嗎？

string.name: c25_f2
string.value: 試試繼續你的玩笑看看有什麼後果。

string.name: c26_s2
string.value: 在你的臉上放個微笑吧。

string.name: c26_s3
string.value: 讓我給你看看怎麼嚇壞一個人…

string.name: c26_f1
string.value: 別在公共場合做愚蠢的事情。

string.name: c26_f3
string.value: 好無聊…我回去鏡子裡面了。

string.name: c27_s1
string.value: 你的腿比我短。你追不上我！

string.name: c27_s2
string.value: 這是我抒發我自己的方法。

string.name: c27_f2
string.value: 你連一點格調都沒有嗎？

string.name: c27_f3
string.value: 你能給我更有挑戰性的任務嗎？

string.name: c28_s1
string.value: 我是好小孩皮卡啾…喜歡早睡~

string.name: c28_s4
string.value: 晚安，主人…我愛…愛…Z z z…

string.name: c28_f3
string.value: 和我玩久一點行嗎…拜託…

string.name: c29_s1
string.value: 如果我踢被的話你能幫我蓋上嗎？

string.name: c29_s3
string.value: 你能在大太陽曬我屁股之前叫醒我嗎？

string.name: c29_f1
string.value: 這裡太吵令到我無法入睡…

string.name: c29_f2
string.value: 你看到我的黑眼圈了嗎？我失眠了…

string.name: c29_f3
string.value: 我不管，今晚我決定不睡覺！！！

string.name: c30_s3
string.value: *彈跳聲*！ 彈上了雲端~~~皮卡~~~~

string.name: c30_s4
string.value: 我的性格也很有彈性~皮卡皮卡~~~

string.name: c30_f4
string.value: 我不覺得我們彼此瞭解對方…

string.name: f2_f
string.value: 我吃不下了…我的胃快脹破了。

string.name: f4_s
string.value: 皮卡。我好喜愛這個！ 這太美味了~！！！

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: 我正好想休息……谢谢主人～

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: 算了吧～我更喜欢在天上飞？

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: 那我坐下歇会儿。嘴巴太重了。

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: 太好了～我能继续坐着吗？

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: 是啊～我们休息一下再走吧。今天走得太多了～

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: 你看我的嘴巴大就看不起我吗？我会飞！

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: 喂喂……累了的话你自己坐下休息吧。

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: 让鸟坐下……你让我怎么坐啊！

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: 对不起，听不懂你在说啥

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: 呜呜，没想到主人这么讨厌我……

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: 啊～～你这样说，我会很难过的～～

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: 怎么能这么说我……今天嘴巴好像更沉了……

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: 我渴望爱，没想到你竟然说出这么伤人的话，讨厌～

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: 你以为这就能让我生气吗？回去好好练练吧。

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: 不喜欢干嘛买我啊？不是自找苦头吗～哈哈哈

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: 我是傻瓜的话，你也是傻瓜？上梁不正下梁歪？噜啦啦啦～

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: 啊，主人，我错了。原谅我吧T_T

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: 你走吧，让我一个人呆着。

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: 每天都说我……你以为我那么好欺负吗？！

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: 我不想被人骂～我该怎么办？

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: 别骂我，请称赞我～请抚摸我的喙～

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: 我会去那边乖乖站着，就饶我一次吧～

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: 你要教训到什么时候啊？不好意思，我很饿……得先吃饭。

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: 不知道你到底在说些什么。咕噜咕噜～你知道我在说什么吗？

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: 你以为我会害怕吗？不，我一点都不怕！嘻嘻

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: 主人像太阳一样灼热的爱情！

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: 我只爱我自己。我很自恋～

string.name: c16_s1
string.value: 我会一直陪伴主人，直到升到最高级～

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: 嘻嘻～真高兴。主人也和我一样吧？

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: 真难为情，我的嘴巴都变红了～

string.name: c16_f1
string.value: 我已经有恋人了……您找错人了～

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: 我会考虑的，但别抱太大的希望……虽然我不想伤害你，咕噜～

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: 你是8头身……不是我这样的2头身～

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: 我的大嘴巴……实在太沉了

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: 好的……刚好挺无聊，和我一起玩吧

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: 我现在很忙……过一会再来找我。

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: 先给我吃饭，在让我干活。

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: 哈哈，唠叨可是我特长中的特长。可能会有点吵，没关系吧？

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: 今天天气真不错～感觉像喝了超级药水一样～

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: 一般人嘴巴沉的话，就不怎么爱说话。我正好相反，哈哈哈。

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: 让我们在蔚蓝大海和金色的阳光下漫步，讲述刻骨铭心的爱情吧～

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: 我本来很爱说话，但现在肚子很饿。你得先给点东西我吃。

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: 我讲了这么久，现在轮到你讲了。让我来听听看。

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: 现在是睡觉时间……我们明天再说。

string.name: c19_f4

string.value: 真的吗？我也觉得老兄你满不错的！

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: 老兄~你的心意我心领了，先来的吃的吧！

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: 主人你那种表情…很难令人相信耶~

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: 自然是人，去和人谈恋爱吧！形单影只也太久了吧~

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: 喔！好习惯啦~我也没觉得怎样…你看到的爱心都是错觉啦~

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: 主人笨蛋！干嘛那么大声讲啊？别人都听到了嘛~

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: 好害羞喔~~虽然还是很开心~

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: 哎呀呀呀~我怎么突然不能动了？难道是因为太开心了吗？

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: 太常讲，反而会让人无法相信喔~

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: 如果一直讲些奇怪的话，就离我远一点…

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: 我知道你也挺孤单的啦！但向自己的宠物告白，会不会太怪了点？

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: 你别把我和孙悟空那只野猴子相提并论！

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: 你有没有看到一只活蹦乱跳的野猴子啊？

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: 天热了…最适合吃西瓜了！

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: 别问我宠物饲料是什么味道，只要吃上一口你就会明白的！

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: 我没心情说话~齁齁…不然老兄你先说吧！

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: 饿都快要饿死了，哪有力气说话啊？

string.name: c22_s1
string.value: 成为玩偶的感觉很差喔~我宁可被关在监狱里~

string.name: c22_s2
string.value: 我乃天蓬元帅猪八戒大爷！哇哈哈哈哈哈~

string.name: c22_s3
string.value: 我不要挨饿，也不要被骂，但最讨厌被人不理不睬…

string.name: c22_s4
string.value: 我没办法跟其它宠物对话，我们实在是没办法沟通…

string.name: c22_f1
string.value: 如果老兄愿意先开口的话，那我在考虑看看~

string.name: c22_f2
string.value: 别又莫名奇妙要我做些奇怪的事情~

string.name: c22_f3
string.value: 之前还说我太多嘴，现在又要我说话，你到底想要怎样啊？

string.name: c22_f4
string.value: 老兄你也满无聊的嘛！还想要跟宠物对话~

string.name: c23_s1
string.value: 要怎么变身啊？我也很想教你，但我想你应该没办法领会~

string.name: c23_s2
string.value: 你知道吗？我曾经是天界一个叫天蓬元帅的将军喔！

string.name: c23_s3
string.value: 坦白讲，其它宠物都太没有个人风格，你说对不对？

string.name: c23_s4
string.value: 主人你也该打扮一下啦！穿上我的衣服和武器…应该会有意想不到的效果吧！

string.name: c23_f1
string.value: 如果是主人你的话，会说什么话呢？

string.name: c23_f2
string.value: 在公共场合不可喧哗！主人要有公德心啦！

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: 你别再烦我啦~让我安静地想一想~

string.name: c23_f4
string.value: 说话啊？没啥好说的！老兄你和我很熟吗？

string.name: c24_s1
string.value: 哎呀…已经到睡眠时间啦？齁齁...

string.name: c24_s2
string.value: 我虽然还是精力旺盛，但休息片刻应该也不错吧！

string.name: c24_s3
string.value: 老兄你要不要也来睡一下？看起来很累说~

string.name: c24_f1
string.value: 还没开饭前，拒绝入眠~齁齁~

string.name: c24_f3
string.value: 我怎么可能会睡在这种地板？

string.name: c25_s3
string.value: 时间到了你在叫醒我喔！

string.name: c25_f1
string.value: 不困还要我一直睡…主人你是不是有什么不良意图？

string.name: c25_f2
string.value: 为了磨练自己的变身术，我可没时间睡觉！

string.name: c25_f3
string.value: 只顾着要我睡，都不给东西吃…主人你太过分！

string.name: c26_f1
string.value: 我正在自我挑战，看可以不睡多久~

string.name: c26_f2
string.value: 等我睡着了，你就会丢下我自己跑掉，对吧？我才不要税呢~

string.name: c26_f3
string.value: 我不困！我的黑眼圈不是因为睡眠不足，而是因为营养不良！

string.name: c27_s1
string.value: 请看！我这华丽的变身术！我变~

string.name: c27_s3
string.value: 看清楚啰~不然会吓一跳喔！

string.name: c27_f1
string.value: 这可不是随随便便就可以施展的技术！

string.name: c27_f2
string.value: 齁齁…自己都不会变身了，还想要我来做啊？

string.name: c27_f3
string.value: 先来点吃的吧！饿着肚子可是什么也做不好~

string.name: c28_s1
string.value: 既然是主人的命令！我变我变我变变变~

string.name: c28_s2
string.value: 让我来展现一下苦练多日的变身术吧！齁齁~

string.name: c28_s3
string.value: OK~没问题~这可是我的强项呢！

string.name: c28_f1
string.value: 你是不是想要把我送到自由市场卖啊？说是什么会变身的宠物之类的…

string.name: c28_f2
string.value: 你又没认真在看，怎么没事就要我变身啊？

string.name: c28_f3
string.value: 你一定觉得我变身的样子很好笑，才要我变身的吧？

string.name: f2_f
string.value: 我还OK！别以为我每天竟想着要吃东西~

string.name: f3_s
string.value: 齁齁！好吃好吃~我要多吃点，这样才能像以前当元帅时那样，变得威风八面~

string.name: f3_f
string.value: ... 不好吃…老兄~有没有什么好吃点的？

string.name: f4_s
string.value: 只要是主人给的，我想一定都非常好吃~

string.name: f4_f
string.value: 都已经饱了还逼我吃东西，这样太不人道了吧~

string.name: c2_f2
string.value: 可以不要一直叫我坐下吗？

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: 这里脏脏的说~要坐在这里吗？

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: 为什么一直叫我坐下呢？

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: 到现在还在教我坐下啊？

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: 只要是你的吩咐~我都会照办~

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: 我现在比较想跟主人玩~

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: 坐下对我来说太简单了~

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: 有没有什么好吃的东西呢？

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: 我怕屁屁会越坐越大耶~

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: 屁屁痛痛的~现在不想坐~

string.name: c6_s1
string.value: 好累哦，终于可以休息了~

string.name: c6_s2
string.value: 嗯…我正想好好休息~主人真体贴~

string.name: c6_s3
string.value: 休息是为了走更长远的路~

string.name: c6_f1
string.value: 一直叫我休息会害我变懒惰哦~

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: 我休息够了~带我去玩吧~

string.name: c7_s1
string.value: 太棒了~终于可以休息了~

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: 我现在不想玩~ 可以跟我一起休息吗？

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: 为什么一直叫我休息呢？

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: 我现在不累啊~可以不要休息吗？

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: 我肚子饿了~可以吃东西了吗？

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: 真想这样一直休息下去~

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: 唔~我正好觉得累呢~谢谢主人~

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: 休息是为了走更长远的路~~

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: 我肚子好饿哦~我想吃东西~

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: 我比较想陪主人去冒险~

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: 我休息够了~我们去玩吧！

string.name: c10_s2
string.value: 主人~好好跟我说我会听话的~

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: 主人可以不要这么凶吗？

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: 我很乖的~我会好好听你的话~

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: 你没事就骂我~我讨厌你

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: 主人的口气可以和善一点吗？

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: 对~对不起~我下次不敢了~

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: 主人~你可以好好跟我说吗？

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: 好~我会好好听主人的话~

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: 我已经被你骂到麻木了~

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: 我没有做错事~你为什么要这么凶

string.name: c14_s1
string.value: 可以到隐密一点的地方吗？

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: 呼~差一点就忍不住了说~

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: 我今天喝的水不多，所以不想嘘嘘耶~

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: 在这里吗？我想换个地方~

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: 我现在不想嘘嘘耶~晚点吧！

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: 这~这没办法说上就上的~

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: 我不想一直待在你身边

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: 那以后可以不要一直骂我吗？

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: 骗人骗人~你刚刚才在骂我

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: 在主人身边~我觉得好幸福哦~

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: 可是主人都常常对我凶~

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: 你只是随便说说而已吧~

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: 哇伊~~~你不要那么说。我脸都红透了~

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: 你要一直这样爱着我哦~

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: 骂完我之后才来哄我的吗？

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: 我好喜欢听哦~可以再说一次吗？

string.name: c22_s3
string.value: 你看你看~我站起来了耶~

string.name: c23_s3
string.value: 主人只是想看我表演吗？

string.name: c23_f1
string.value: 我肚子饿了~可以先吃饭吗？

string.name: c23_f2
string.value: 可以不要叫我做这些事吗？

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: 我现在不想站着耶~可以不要站吗？

string.name: c23_f4
string.value: 先吃饭吧~吃完才有力气~

string.name: c24_s2
string.value: 哇~站着果然看的比较远~

string.name: c24_s3
string.value: 主人~一直站着很累的说~

string.name: c24_f2
string.value: 比起站着~我更想要坐着~

string.name: c24_f3
string.value: 可以先吃饭吗？我有点饿~

string.value: 你有看过动物会说话吗？

string.name: c25_s3
string.value: 主人有什么心事想跟我聊吗？

string.name: c25_s4
string.value: 主人喜欢什么样的宠物呢？

string.name: c25_f1
string.value: 我想交很多像主人这样的朋友~

string.name: c25_f2
string.value: 主人平常都在哪边练功啊？

string.name: c25_f3
string.value: 玩游戏也别忘了休息时间哦~

string.name: c25_f4
string.value: 主人喜欢什么样的运动啊？

string.name: c26_f3
string.value: 主人很喜欢跟人聊天啊~

string.name: c26_f4
string.value: 我们吃完饭后再聊可以吗？

string.name: c27_s1
string.value: 我好饿哦~可以吃东西了吗？

string.name: c27_f1
string.value: 有准备我喜欢吃的东西吗？

string.name: c28_f2
string.value: 主人~我不會挑食的，主人也不會吧？

string.name: c28_f3
string.value: 要多吃青菜~才會健康哦~

string.name: c29_s2
string.value: 因为都有按时吃饭~所以才会头好壮壮

string.name: c29_s3
string.value: 哇伊~这都是我喜欢吃的耶~

string.name: c29_s4
string.value: 唔~好饱好饱~我吃好饱哦~

string.name: c29_f2
string.value: 不要再叫我吃了，我真的吃不下了~

string.name: c29_f4
string.value: 吃得适量才能维持好身材~

string.name: c30_f1
string.value: 我会努力学的~请给我一点时间~

string.name: c30_f2
string.value: 我有一直在进步了~不要这么严苛嘛~

string.name: c31_s3
string.value: 一点小失败不代表全部啊~

string.name: c31_f1
string.value: 呜~我好难过~你这样说我~

string.name: c31_f2
string.value: 主人~你是不是嫌弃我了~

string.name: c31_f3
string.value: 主人~我更须要你的鼓励~

string.name: c31_f4
string.value: 可以给我时间让我好好学习吗？

string.name: c32_s3
string.value: 你再嫌弃我，我就不理你了~

string.name: c32_s4
string.value: 每件事都须要时间学习的~

string.name: c32_f2
string.value: 我是很利害的~只是主人不知道而已~

string.name: c33_f1
string.value: 主人~你有听到什么声音吗？

string.name: c33_f3
string.value: 主人~你刚刚有说什么吗？

string.name: c34_f1
string.value: 奇怪~耳朵都听不到声音~

string.name: c34_f2
string.value: 我在睡觉~别跟我说话哦~

string.name: c34_f3
string.value: 咦~好像有听到什么声音~

string.name: c35_s1
string.value: 没看到我在睡觉吗~当然听不到啊~

string.name: c35_s3
string.value: 主人~我想我要来去看耳科了~

string.name: c35_f2
string.value: 主人~你有听到谁在说话吗？

string.name: c35_f3
string.value: 好困哦~脑袋没办法思考了~

string.name: c35_f4
string.value: 听不到~听不到~什么都听不到~
